messages.subject: Project Onyx - first draft Subscription & Shareholders' Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Please find attached the first draft of the Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement for Project Onyx. It follows the term sheet and includes the full warranty schedule and limitations at Schedule 5. We've begun the new Articles and the Investor Rights Agreement and will circulate those next week. We look forward to your mark-up in the new year.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
